He sells various items once an animal is brought to him. He also appears in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}}, allowing players to use the [[Crop Analyzer]]. == Shop == Once an animal is brought to '''Jake''', the item in his shop is available to all players in I'll add you now. &e[NPC] &eJake&f: &b✆ &fBut don't call me after 8pm, please. }} |} == Tips == * Players can use [[Lead]]s, {{potN|Jump Boost Potion}}s, or [[Grappling Hook]]s to quickly climb up the mountain with an animal. ** The most consistent method is to use a [[Huntaxes|Huntaxe]] and [[Black Holes|Black Hole]]. Due to animals not having shards, they will float permanently into the black hole. You can move the black hole towards the mountain, taking as many animals as you wish at once. Move the black hole repeatedly until the animals levitate on top of the hut's roof. ** The classic method is to combine a lead with [[Spider's Boots]] or [[Tarantula Boots]] and double-jump to the very top. The animal will only take damage based on the distance from its highest point to the elevation of the spot it lands on, so it will take minimal damage only once when it lands on top of the mountain. The mana cost of these abilities can be reduced with a {{Item|Sheep Pet}} or {{Item|Tarantula Pet}}. ** Another method, although more difficult and expensive, is to use Spirit Boots to fly up the mountain. The boots will get you up the mountain in 2 flights because flights are very short. ** In order to get a Cow or Pig, it's recommended to land in the oasis to reset the potential fall damage before going up the mountain. *The Loch Emperor is not consumed from the summoning item after talking to Jake, meaning the player can unlock the Golden Ball item an infinite amount of times as long as they have the summon. == Gallery == File:Jake (Underground Lab).png|'''Jake''' while in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Crop Analyzer (Area).png|Crop Analyzer and '''Jake''' in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Jake's House (Render).png|[[Jake's House]] on top of the mountain == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 10|link=none|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|2026/July 15|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} {{History|2026/Oct 15|Moved '''Jake''' and his house from {{Coords|261.5|184|-565.5}} to {{Coords|245.5|95|-344.5}}.}} |beta= {{History|2021/April 21|[[File:Jake.png|26px]] Added '''Jake'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|0.26.1|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
